stemBlocks.value: Quadrilateral P is drawn on a square grid with vertices (-7, 7), (-8, 6), (-6, 6) and (-7, 4). On the grid, draw the image of P after (i) a translation by the vector (10, -4), labelling it P', and (ii) a reflection in the line y = 0, labelling it P".
Think first: Both transformations act on the four vertices one at a time, so find the image of each corner and then join them in the same order.

stemBlocks.altText: Source visual for edmar-csec-p260-q01 from workbook page 260.

solutionSteps.instruction: Read the coordinates of the four vertices of P from the grid.

contentBlocks.value: Top corner, left corner, right corner, bottom corner.

solutionSteps.instruction: Apply the translation rule: add 10 to every x-coordinate and subtract 4 from every y-coordinate.
Plot those four points and join them in the same order to draw P'.

contentBlocks.value: P' is the same size and the same way up as P; only its position changes.
Result: Kite P' drawn between x = 2 and x = 4, y = 0 and y = 3

solutionSteps.instruction: Apply the reflection in y = 0 (the x-axis): keep each x-coordinate and change the sign of each y-coordinate.
Plot those four points and join them to draw P".

contentBlocks.value: P" is the mirror image of P below the x-axis; it is the same distance from the axis as P but upside down.
Result: Kite P" drawn between x = -8 and x = -6, y = -7 and y = -4

strategyBlocks.value: Read the four vertices of P off the grid, apply the rule (x, y) -> (x + 10, y - 4) for the translation, then the rule (x, y) -> (x, -y) for the reflection in y = 0, and plot each image.

whyThisWorks.value: A translation slides every point of a shape by the same displacement, so adding the column vector to each coordinate pair moves the whole figure without turning or resizing it. A reflection in y = 0 sends each point to the point the same perpendicular distance on the other side of the x-axis, which leaves x unchanged and reverses the sign of y. Both are isometries, so the image is always congruent to the object.

commonErrors.misconception: Reversing the components of the vector and moving 10 down and 4 across.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Reversing the components of the vector and moving 10 down and 4 across.

commonErrors.misconception: Subtracting instead of adding the top component of the translation vector.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Subtracting instead of adding the top component of the translation vector.

commonErrors.misconception: Reflecting in x = 0 (the y-axis) instead of y = 0, changing the sign of x instead of y.
commonErrors.correctiveNote: Avoid this: Reflecting in x = 0 (the y-axis) instead of y = 0, changing the sign of x instead of y.

commonErrors.misconception: Joining the image points in a different order, which distorts the shape.

examTip.value: Write the object's vertices in a list, transform them one line at a time, then plot. Marks are given for correct coordinates even if your drawing is untidy.

promptBlocks.value: The point (-5, 3) is translated by the vector (10, -4) and then reflected in y = 0. Where does it end up?

answerSpec.displayValue: (5, -1) after the translation, then (5, 1) after the reflection.
acceptedForms: (5, -1) after the translation, then (5, 1) after the reflection.
